_comment: EXAMPLE permission rules for policy.mjs, which compiles them into the harness's own permission engine (OpenCode's config.permission) at startup. The installer copies this to policy/allowlist.json on first run; edit that file freely. Patterns are GLOBS, not regexes, and are passed through verbatim — write what you would type to the shell. They are leading-* wildcards on purpose: over-matching costs an unnecessary prompt, under-matching silently skips a rule you thought was armed. No catch-all is emitted, so anything unmatched keeps your own default.
